JEE Main Session 2 Result 2026: Mark Your Calendars for April 20!

The wait is almost over for lakhs of engineering aspirants! The National Testing Agency (NTA) is gearing up to release the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main Session 2 results for 2026. Candidates who appeared for the April session can expect their scorecards to be available very soon, with a highly anticipated date for the announcement.

According to the latest updates, the JEE Main Session 2 Result 2026 is tentatively scheduled to be released on **April 20, 2026**.

This announcement is crucial as it will determine eligibility for JEE Advanced 2026 and subsequent admissions to prestigious institutions like NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs through JoSAA counselling. Stay tuned as we delve into how to check your results, what information your scorecard will contain, and important dates to keep in mind.

How to Check Your JEE Main Session 2 Result 2026

Accessing your JEE Main Session 2 scorecard is a straightforward process. Follow these steps to ensure a smooth experience:

1. Visit the Official Website
Navigate to the official JEE Main website: jeemain.nta.nic.in.
2. Locate the Result Link
Look for the link typically labeled "Result of JEE (Main)" or "JEE Main 2026 Session 2 Result" on the homepage and click on it.
3. Enter Your Credentials
You will be prompted to enter your application number and password or date of birth.
4. View and Download Scorecard
After submitting your details, your JEE Main 2026 Session 2 scorecard will be displayed on the screen. Download it and take a printout for your records, as it will be vital for future admission processes. The scorecard will remain accessible until July 31, 2026.

What Your Scorecard Will Reveal

The JEE Main Session 2 scorecard is more than just a list of marks. It provides comprehensive details essential for your academic journey. Here's what you can expect to find:

✅ Candidate's Name and Application Number

✅ Subject-wise Percentile Scores (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics)

✅ Total NTA Score (Overall Percentile)

✅ All India Rank (AIR)

✅ Category Rank (if applicable)

✅ JEE Advanced Qualification Status

For candidates who appeared in both Session 1 and Session 2, the NTA considers the best of the two scores for the final result and All India Rank.

Key Dates for JEE Main 2026

Understanding the timeline for JEE Main 2026 is crucial for all aspirants. Here's a quick overview of significant dates:

Event Session 1 (January) Session 2 (April)
Exam Dates January 21-29, 2026 April 2-8, 2026
Provisional Answer Key Release February 4, 2026 April 11, 2026
Answer Key Objection Period February 4-6, 2026 By April 13, 2026
Result Declaration (Paper 1) February 16, 2026 April 20, 2026 (Tentative)
Result Declaration (Paper 2) February 24, 2026 1st week of May 2026 (Tentative)

It's important to note that the NTA reviews objections to the provisional answer key, and if discrepancies are confirmed, a revised final answer key is uniformly applied to all candidates. Candidates are not individually notified about the acceptance of their objections.

What's Next? JEE Advanced & JoSAA Counselling

For those who successfully clear the JEE Main cutoff, the next major step is JEE Advanced 2026. The JEE Advanced 2026 exam is scheduled for May 17, 2026, and will be conducted in two sessions: Paper 1 from 9 am to 12 noon, and Paper 2 from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm.

Following JEE Advanced, the Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) will conduct counselling for admissions to IITs, NITs, IIITs, and other GFTIs. Your JEE Main All India Rank and category rank will play a significant role in this counselling process.

Stay Updated!

As the official result date draws near, it's highly recommended that candidates frequently visit the NTA JEE Main official website (jeemain.nta.nic.in) for the latest announcements and direct links. Wishing all the candidates the very best for their results!
